title: Phase 2 — Data layer (Supabase Postgres + Drizzle)
summary: Detailed implementation plan for Phase 2 data layer with Supabase Postgres, Drizzle ORM, RLS, and supporting infrastructure.
notes: Classified as SPEC due to heavy implementation details: 16 entity schema definitions with column types/indexes, exact SQL migration code, Drizzle config and client code, connection string specifications, package.json scripts, and CI workflow YAML. Also contains ADR-like 'Why this pivot' section explaining Convex→Supabase decision, and PRD-like goals/acceptance criteria. SPEC signals dominate — the document is primarily an implementation contract describing how the data layer must be built.
